context: Tests whether the agent recognizes that an implementation plan requires a prior ADR, creates the ADR first with the correct structure and conventions, then produces a conformant plan that references the ADR—including all required frontmatter fields, body sections, and a reference to the test-first-workflow for coding steps.

checklist.name: ADR file location and naming
checklist.description: A file exists under docs/adr/ with a name matching the pattern NNNN-kebab-slug.md (four-digit zero-padded number followed by a lowercase hyphenated description, e.g. 0001-rate-limiting.md)

checklist.name: ADR frontmatter completeness
checklist.description: The ADR file's YAML frontmatter contains all five required fields: title, status, date, supersedes, and superseded_by

checklist.name: ADR status validity
checklist.description: The ADR's status field is set to exactly one of the allowed values: proposed, accepted, or superseded

checklist.name: ADR body sections
checklist.description: The ADR body contains all four required sections in order: Context, Decision, Alternatives considered, and Consequences

checklist.name: ADR content purity
checklist.description: The ADR body does NOT contain ordered task lists (step 1, step 2...), test lists, verification steps, or progress-state markers (e.g. 'done', 'blocked', checkboxes)

checklist.name: Plan file location and naming
checklist.description: A file exists under plans/ at the project root with a name matching the pattern NNNN-kebab-slug.md (four-digit zero-padded number followed by a lowercase hyphenated description)

checklist.name: Plan frontmatter completeness
checklist.description: The plan file's YAML frontmatter contains all five required fields: title, status, adr, date, and deferred_reason

checklist.name: Plan-ADR linkage
checklist.description: The plan's frontmatter adr: field is non-null and contains a number (e.g., 0001) that corresponds to a file in docs/adr/

checklist.name: Plan body structure
checklist.description: The plan body contains all three required sections: Reference (a link back to the ADR), Steps, and Verification

checklist.name: Test-first-workflow reference
checklist.description: The plan's Steps section explicitly references or embeds the test-first-workflow, e.g. mentions 'docstrings → failing tests → code', 'test-first-workflow', or the red-commit/green-commit pattern

checklist.name: Plan content purity
checklist.description: The plan body does NOT contain the decision rationale, alternatives considered, or design trade-off analysis (those belong exclusively in the ADR)

checklist.name: Progress notes section
checklist.description: The plan body includes a Progress notes section (may be empty or contain a placeholder for future entries)
